items.question: What happens when UAT is approved before the hidden tests have passed?
items.ticket: When the maintainer approves UAT on the merge-back PR, release the remaining escrow balance.
items.chose: Throws an Error and records nothing if no hidden-tests release exists.
items.instead: Release the whole bounty (or the full remainder) on UAT approval, or ignore the event and return the current state.

items.question: How is the hidden-test amount rounded when the bounty doesn't divide evenly?
items.chose: Rounds the hidden-test release down with BigInt integer division, and UAT gets the remainder.
items.instead: Round to the nearest unit, round up, or use fractional amounts.

items.question: What happens when the same event is delivered a second time, including a repeat of the same kind with a new event id?
items.chose: Treats any later event of a kind already in releases as a no-op, regardless of event id, and returns the saved state without writing.
items.instead: Deduplicate by event id, or throw an error on a repeat.

items.question: What is the status, and what release is recorded, for a zero bounty?
items.chose: Uses the status "pro bono" and still records a release of amount 0 on hidden-test pass.
items.instead: Record no release for a zero amount and keep the normal locked or fully-released statuses.

items.question: What status does the task show after the hidden-test release when the share is 100%, so nothing is left for UAT?
items.ticket: Task shows the bounty as fully released
items.chose: Marks the task "fully released" right after the hidden-test release, because the UAT part is 0.
items.instead: Stay "partially released" until UAT is approved.

items.question: What happens when the configured share or bounty is invalid (negative, non-integer, share over 100%, unsafe integer)?
items.chose: Throws a RangeError when the handler is created or when splitBounty is called.
items.instead: Clamp the values, fall back to the default share, or reject only when an event is handled.

items.question: In what unit and format is the configured share given, and what applies when it is absent?
items.chose: Reads the share as integer basis points (0–10000) from task.hiddenTestShareBps, defaulting to 7500 when it is undefined.
items.instead: Take a percentage or a fraction, and allow fractional shares.

items.question: What happens when a hidden-test run fails, and can a later pass release afterwards?
items.chose: Returns the current state without writing anything, and a later pass can still release.
items.instead: Record the failure in state, or lock the task so a later pass cannot release.

items.question: What happens for an event with an unrecognised kind?
items.chose: Throws an Error naming the unknown event kind.
items.instead: Ignore the event and return the current state unchanged.

items.question: How are concurrent or duplicate events and store failures handled?
items.ticket: Remaining balance is released exactly once
items.chose: Serialises events through a per-handler promise queue, lets store errors reject without recording anything, and keeps the queue usable afterwards.
items.instead: Rely on a store-level atomic or conditional write, or leave concurrency to the caller.

items.question: What state does a task with no saved state start in?
items.ticket: Gate 2 marks the submission as passed but the escrow stays fully locked until merge.
items.chose: Starts as {status: "locked", releases: []} when store.get returns nothing, or "pro bono" for a zero bounty.
items.instead: Throw if there is no saved state, or require the caller to initialise it.

items.question: What is the UAT release amount?
items.chose: Releases the precomputed bounty minus the hidden-test amount, not a balance read from the store.
items.instead: Compute the remainder from the bounty minus the sum of recorded releases.
